answer: The strongest lever is simple: make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because ridge only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. Concretely, copper is enforced in the ledger: Detection is retrospective: payouts for a flagged cluster are clawed back after the fact. Any forge approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
